title: Crunchyroll Releases New Trailer for 2027’s Most Viral Anime Yet
content:
2027 is only a few months away, bringing with it a new wave of anime, and with Crunchyroll being the major streaming platform for anime, it will be the primary destination for many of these upcoming series. Winter 2027 is shaping up to be an exciting season for anime fans, with plenty of new series featuring unique premises. While the lineup already includes a variety of anime, the season is also set to feature several series that use comedy as their main element. However, one of the most unique among them is The Guy She Was Interested in Wasn’t a Guy at All .

Adapted from the manga of the same name, the upcoming anime is exactly what its intriguing title suggests. Produced by CloverWorks, the series follows a high school girl named Aya, who has a particular taste in music: rock. While searching for new music, she discovers a CD shop with a masked clerk dressed entirely in black, whom Aya finds incredibly attractive. However, the hilarious twist is that the clerk is actually a girl who happens to be her classmate, Mitsuki. The newly released trailer for the anime, which is set to premiere in January 2027 , offers a deeper look at this premise and hints at why the series could go viral.

Crunchyroll’s Most Unique Slice-of-Life Anime Could Go Viral in January 2027

The trailer for The Guy She Was Interested in Wasn’t a Guy at All also confirms that its premise goes beyond Aya mistaking Mitsuki for a guy and developing a crush on her. It is revealed that Mitsuki enjoys the attention from Aya and hearing about her crush at school, where the two sit next to each other. Despite her introverted personality and tendency to stay out of the spotlight, Mitsuki indulges Aya’s antics, and the two grow closer as they share their love for music. The series also falls under the yuri, or girls’ love, genre, which remains relatively rare in the anime industry, especially among series with the level of ambition this anime appears to have.

With CloverWorks adapting the series, the trailers showcase the high quality the anime is aiming for, further reinforced by Masashi Ishihama, known for his work on The Girl Who Leapt Through Time , serving as director. CloverWorks is also known for adapting intriguing anime featuring female characters , such as Wonder Egg Priority . While The Guy She Was Interested in Wasn’t a Guy at All is not as fantastical as Wonder Egg Priority , it has its own unique appeal, particularly in the slice-of-life genre, which is often criticized for relying on similar elements.

Looking deeper into the story, the anime aims to explore what it means to like someone and fall in love with them. By depicting two protagonists with their own quirks who find comfort in each other, the series shows how their differences bring them closer. With these elements and its arrival on Crunchyroll on January 8, 2027, The Guy She Was Interested in Wasn’t a Guy at All is aiming to become one of next year’s most viral anime.

title: Noa Is My Senior and My Friend Anime Reveals Key Visual, Main Cast
content:
Noa Is My Senior and My Friend anime revealed a key visual and its main cast. Studio feel. is animating the series, set to premiere in 2027 and it stars Rina Kawaguchi as Noa Saotome and Tomoya Ito as Rihito Otsuka.

Shinsuke Yanagi is directing the anime with Keiichiro Ochi is writing the series scripts. Yumiko Yamamoto is the character designer. Enma Akiyama writes and illustrates the manga the anime is adapted from. Weekly Young Jump has been serializing the series since 2023 and has 11 volumes in circulation. The 12th volume is set to be released on October 19, 2026.

The series follows Rihito Otsuka, who works at a game company under Noa Saotome, an art director admired by her colleagues for her strong work ethic. However, Otsuka soon discovers a side of his senior that she keeps hidden from everyone else. Source: Noa Is My Senior and My Friend anime Official website , X (formerly Twitter) ©Enma Akiyama /Shueisha/Noa Senpai is a friend. Production committee

title: Manga 'Nue no Onmyouji' Gets TV Anime in Summer 2027
content:
The sixth Jump Press livestream event announced a television anime adaptation of Kouta Kawae 's Nue no Onmyouji ( Nue's Exorcist ) manga on Monday, revealing the main cast, staff, a teaser visual (pictured), and an announcement promotional video. The anime is scheduled to premiere on TV Asahi in Summer 2027.

Cast Nue: Saori Oonishi ( Dungeon ni Deai wo Motomeru no wa Machigatteiru Darou ka ) Gakurou Yajima: Kaito Miura ( Tougen Anki ) Kazusa Suou: Sayumi Suzushiro ( Megami no Café Terrace )

Staff Director: Hiroyuki Hashimoto ( Youkoso Jitsuryoku Shijou Shugi no Kyoushitsu e , Gochuumon wa Usagi desu ka? ) Series Composition: Hiroshi Seko ( Jujutsu Kaisen ) Character Design: Shunpei Mochizuki ( Sakugan ) Sound Director: Takayuki Yamaguchi ( Kami no Tou ) Music: MONACA ( NieR:Automata Ver1.1a ) Studio: Studio Hibari

Kawae began serializing the supernatural action manga in Weekly Shounen Jump in May 2023. Shueisha published the 16th volume on September 4, with the 17th volume scheduled to be released on November 4. Nue no Onmyouji has a cumulative 1.6 million copies in circulation.

Shueisha has simulpublished the manga digitally in English through their Manga Plus platform since March 2023. Viz media has licenced the manga digitally since February 2024, and in print since October 2024. The eighth volume went on sale on September 1, with the ninth volume scheduled to be released on November 3.

Nue no Onmyouji placed seventh in the print category of the 2024 Next Manga Awards .

Synopsis Gakurou Yajima has been able to see genyou, a kind of youkai that nobody else notices, since he was a child. He's learned to live with it. Then he starts high school, and the school turns out to have a room that no one knows about.

Someone has been living in it. She's a genyou named Nue, a girl who loves video games and has spent years sitting in that room waiting for a person to find it. Gakurou does, and the two of them meet.

From there the story follows Gakurou and Nue around the school grounds as he takes his first steps as a modern-day onmyouji.

Announcement

title: Kōta Kawae's Nue's Exorcist Manga Gets TV Anime in Summer 2027
content:
The Jump Press livestream on Monday announced that Kōta Kawae 's Nue's Exorcist ( Nue no Onmyōji ) manga is getting a television anime adaptation that will debut in summer 2027 on TV Asahi , and also revealed the teaser video, teaser visual, main cast, and main staff members.

Hiroyuki Hashimoto ( Classroom of the Elite , Laidbackers , Magical Girl Raising Project ) is directing the anime at Studio Hibari . Hiroshi Seko ( Dorohedoro , DAN DA DAN ) is overseeing the series scripts, Shunpei Mochizuki ( Sakugan ) is designing the characters, Takayuki Yamaguchi ( Laidbackers , Dead Mount Death Play , Classroom For Heroes ) is the sound director, and MONACA ( NieR:Automata Ver 1.1a ) is composing the music.

The anime will star:

• Kaito Miura as Gakuro Yajima

• Saori Ōnishi as Nue

• Sayumi Suzushiro as Kazusa Suo

Shueisha 's MANGA Plus service publishes the manga digitally, and Viz Media publishes the manga digitally and physically in English. Viz describes the manga's story:

A powerful spirit awaits the right human to free her—and she's ready for some PVP! For as long as he can remember, Gakuro Yajima's been able to see spirits—beings that are drawn to human sadness and anger. A fateful encounter with a quirky pop culture–loving spirit named Nue marks the start of Gakuro's spirit-exorcist adventure! Outcast Gakuro Yajima's only goal in life has been to avoid spirits and try to live in peace. One day, he accidentally enters a sealed room and meets Nue, a quirky spirit who asks him to defeat the evil ones roaming his school. Gakuro is reluctant to take her up on the offer, but the spirits won't be waiting patiently for him to make up his mind…

Kawae launched the manga in Shueisha 's Weekly Shonen Jump magazine in 2023. Shueisha published the manga's 16th compiled book volume on September 4. Viz Media published the eighth volume in English on September 1.

The manga topped AnimeJapan 2025's "Manga We Want to See Animated" poll.

title: Nue's Exorcist TV Anime Announced for Summer 2027, Main Cast and Staff Revealed
content:
Kota Kawae’s Nue’s Exorcist is officially getting a TV anime adaptation, with the series set to premiere in Summer 2027.

The first cast members have also been announced. Kaito Miura will voice the protagonist Gakuro Yajima, with Saori Onishi as Nue and Sayumi Suzushiro as Kazusa Suo.

Hiroyuki Hashimoto is directing the anime, while Hiroshi Seko is handling series composition. Shunpei Mochizuki serves as character designer, Takayuki Yamaguchi is the sound director, and MONACA is composing the music. Studio HIBARI is handling animation production.

Nue’s Exorcist began serialization in Weekly Shonen Jump in May 2023. It placed first in AnimeJapan 2025’s “Manga We Want to See Animated Ranking,” which received more than 156,000 votes across all nominated titles. title: Everyone's Darling Has a Secret Reveals Teaser Trailer
content:
The previously announced Everyone’s Darling Has a Secret anime has revealed a teaser trailer. Studio Gekko is animating the series and is set to premiere in April 2027.

The voice cast consists of:

• Reiji Kawashima as Hizashi Hiruno

• Hikaru Tono as Rei Kuromiya

• Iori Noguchi as Sakura Akai

• Ami Maeshima as Sora Konno

Hikaru Sato is directing the anime with Fumihiko Shimo in charge of the series scripts. Kibidango 14-go is the character designer, while Satoru Kosaki and MONACA compose the music.

Kashiko Amane writes and illustrates the manga that the anime is based on. Hakusensha is publishing the manga since September 2022. Yen Press is licensing it in English, describing the plot as follows: Hizashi Hiruno, a freshman at a super-elite high school, has just finished his first academic proficiency test of the year. He anxiously awaits the results, which will set the tone for his next three years at school. But due to a mistake on his answer sheet, he receives an abysmal score and gets sent to remedial lessons! If there’s one silver lining, he’s not the only one—and his comrade could be the girl of his dreams?! Source: Everyone’s Darling Has a Secret anime official X (formerly Twitter) , Website © Kashiko Amane / Hakusensha / Blue Impulse/ StarryCube

title: Sonic Racing CrossWorlds Game Reveals Year 2 Roadmap; Sonic the Hedgehog: Memories and Beyond Short Film Reveals Debut Date
content:
Sega revealed on Friday a roadmap for Year Two of its Sonic Racing CrossWorlds game. Year Two will launch on November 3 and the company streamed a video showcasing the new updates.

Year Two will launch with "Duel Mode," a Gadget System upgrade, two new characters Bayonetta and Aigis, and two new machines: McLaren Racing and Butterfly Witch.

The game will release its Godzilla collaboration on November 3 with the launch of Year Two and its Evangelion collaboration in January 2027. The Evangelion collaboration will include two new characters and three new machines.

The Virtual Sanrio Puroland collaboration will launch in Q2 2027 and contain two new characters and two new machines. The Segaland Pack containing the Segaland course, three new machines, and the Midgar Pack (Working Title) from the Final Fantasy VII Remake series will launch in Q3 2027. Sega will release the Reload Revival Royal Pack from the Persona series in Q4 2027.

The season pass content for Year Two will include the Sega Controllers Decal Pack, Consoles Pack, and a pack containing the character Super Shadow and machine Super Dark Flare.

Sega also streamed a trailer for the Sonic the Hedgehog: Memories and Beyond 35th anniversary short film on Friday. The video reveals the short film will debut on November 12

Sega released the game in September 2025 for PlayStation 5, PlayStation 4, Xbox One, Xbox Series X|S, Nintendo Switch, and PC via Steam and Epic Games Store. The game got a release digitally for Nintendo Switch 2 on December 3. There is a Switch 2 upgrade pack for owners of the Switch version, and progress carries over. The physical Switch 2 release with the full game on the cartridge shipped on March 26.

Sonic Racing CrossWorlds features guests from other Sega franchises including Hatsune Miku, Like a Dragon's Ichiban, and Persona 5 's Joker. The game previously had a crossover with the Nickeledeon animated series SpongeBob SquarePants , and also collaborated with CAPCOM for a Mega Man crossover.

The game also collaborated with both Pac-Man and Minecraft as part of Year One. Classic Sonic launched on June 23, Axel from Crazy Taxi debuted in August, and Amigo from Samba de Amigo joined the game in September.

The game also added music from Sega 's Rhythm Thief & the Emperor's Treasure , Feel the Magic: XY/XX , The Rub Rabbits! , and Space Channel 5 . The game had collaborations with the Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles and Avatar: The Last Airbender franchises as part of Year One. The Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles: Mutant Mayhem collaboration debuted in July 2025, and the Avatar Legends collaboration debuted in October 2025.

An animation project for the game debuted in August 2024.

title: Tekken 8 Game Reveals Roger Jr.'s November 11 Early Access Release in Gameplay Trailer
content:
Bandai Namco Entertainment started streaming the gameplay reveal trailer for Roger Jr., one of the characters for the Tekken 8 fighting game's Season 3 , on Sunday. The character will be available for early access on November 11, and will launch officially on November 16. The video also previews the in-game model for another Season 3 character Yūjirō Hanma, the father of protagonist Baki Hanma from the Baki manga and anime series. The video announced that a new Yūjirō Hanma trailer will premiere on January 17 at the Tekken World Tour Finals event, which will be held in Singapore.

Other Season 3 characters include Kunimitsu and Bob. Kunimitsu launched on June 2 in Japan and June 1 in the United States. The character launched on Early Access on May 28 in Japan and May 27 in the U.S. Bob released for early access on August 19, and officially released on August 24. Yūjirō Hanma will debut in early 2027.

Season 2 added Anna Williams in March 2025, Fahkumram in July 2025, Armor King on October 13, and Miary Zo on December 4.

Tekken 8 launched for PlayStation 5, Xbox Series X|S, and PC via Steam in January 2024.

The game featured the following characters at launch: Jin Kazama, Kazuya Mishima, Nina Williams, Jun Kazama, Paul Phoenix, Marshall Law, King, Lars Alexandersson, Jack-8, Ling Xiaoyu, Asuka Kazama, Leroy Smith, Lili, Hwoarang, Bryan, Azucena, Claudio, Raven, Devil Jin, Lee Chaolan, Alisa Bosconovitch, Victor Chevalier, Reina, Leo, Steve, Dragunov, Feng, Yoshimitsu, Shaheen, KUMA, Panda, Zafina, and Lee Chaolan.

The story of the game takes place nearly six months after Tekken 7 . The Guinness World Records recognize the Tekken franchise as having the longest running narrative in video game history.

Eddy Gordo was added to the game in April 2024 as the first DLC character, followed by Lidia Sobieska in July 2024, and Heihachi Mishima in September 2024. The game added Clive Rosfield, the protagonist of Square Enix 's Final Fantasy XVI game, as a playable character in December 2024.

The Tekken: Bloodline anime series, which follows the storyline of the Tekken 3 fighting game, premiered on Netflix in August 2022.

Tekken 8 game director Kohei Ikeda (also known as Nakatsu) announced on June 1 that he has left Bandai Namco Entertainment , having worked at the company for 20 years. Ikeda was the game director on the fighting games Tekken 7 and Tekken 8 , the producer on the Tekken 3D Prime Edition game, and a designer for Tekken Tag Tournament 2 . He was also a designer and battle effect director on SoulCalibur IV .

The game featured the following characters at launch: Jin Kazama, Kazuya Mishima, Nina Williams, Jun Kazama, Paul Phoenix, Marshall Law, King, Lars Alexandersson, Jack-8, Ling Xiaoyu, Asuka Kazama, Leroy Smith, Lili, Hwoarang, Bryan, Azucena, Claudio, Raven, Devil Jin, Lee Chaolan, Alisa Bosconovitch, Victor Chevalier, Reina, Leo, Steve, Dragunov, Feng, Yoshimitsu, Shaheen, KUMA, Panda, Zafina, and Lee Chaolan.
The story of the game takes place nearly six months after Tekken 7 . The Guinness World Records recognize the Tekken franchise as having the longest running narrative in video game history.

Eddy Gordo was added to the game in April 2024 as the first DLC character, followed by Lidia Sobieska in July 2024, and Heihachi Mishima in September 2024. The game added Clive Rosfield, the protagonist of Square Enix 's Final Fantasy XVI game, as a playable character in December 2024.
The Tekken: Bloodline anime series, which follows the storyline of the Tekken 3 fighting game, premiered on Netflix in August 2022.

Tekken 8 game director Kohei Ikeda (also known as Nakatsu) announced on June 1 that he has left Bandai Namco Entertainment , having worked at the company for 20 years. Ikeda was the game director on the fighting games Tekken 7 and Tekken 8 , the producer on the Tekken 3D Prime Edition game, and a designer for Tekken Tag Tournament 2 . He was also a designer and battle effect director on SoulCalibur IV .

title: 5th Girls und Panzer das Finale Film Streams 10-Minute Opening Video
content:
Bandai Namco Filmworks started streaming on Saturday the first 10 minutes of the fifth film in the six-part Girls und Panzer das Finale film series.

The fifth film is set after Ōarai Girls High School's win in the fierce semi-finals of the Winter Continuous Track Cup, and they head to the finals, where they will face St. Gloriana Girls' College, led by Darjeeling. Among the members of St. Gloriana Girls' College is Alice, who transferred to St. Gloriana to be able to face Miho again.

The first Girls und Panzer das Finale film opened in Japan in 59 theaters in December 2017. The film features new characters from BC Freedom High School as they engage in a winter battle.

The second film opened in Japan in June 2019. The film depicts the finale of the battle between Ōarai Girls Academy and BC Freedom High School, and also shows the battles for Kuromorimine Girls Academy, Pravda Girls High School, and other schools.

The third film opened in Japanese theaters in March 2021. The film features six more schools competing on three additional battlegrounds.

The fourth film opened in Japan in October 2023. The fourth film continues with Ōarai's battle with Continuation (Jaktkosota) High School, after the loss of important teammates at the onset of the match in the third film. The film also shows the match between two strong schools, Kuromorimine and St. Gloriana, with Kuromorimine headed up by Maho's successor Erika, and St. Gloriana's commander Darjeeling in her last match.

The four Girls und Panzer: Motto Love Love Sakusen Desu! films opened in order on December 26, January 30, March 6, and April 10. The manga that spawned these films follows the unknown daily lives of the Ōarai Girls Team and other students. Maruko Nii launched the manga in 2013 in Kadokawa 's (then Media Factory 's) Monthly Comic Alive magazine.

The fourth Girls und Panzer: Motto Love Love Sakusen Desu! film included a "pilot video" based on Takeshi Nogami and Takaaki Suzuki 's Girls und Panzer: Ribon no Musha manga .

The Girls und Panzer television anime premiered in October 2012 and had 12 episodes. The Girls und Panzer der Film anime film follow up opened in Japan in November 2015.

title: Marvel Tōkon: Fighting Souls Game Reveals Full Roster for Year 1 DLC
content:
The staff for PlayStation Studios , Arc System Works , and Marvel Games' Marvel Tōkon: Fighting Souls 4v4 tag team fighter game revealed in a new video on Sunday Thor (Jane Foster) as the second DLC character included in the "Year 1 Character & Stage Pass" in winter 2027. The video also introduces the game's first guest musical composer Keiichi Okabe ( Summer Time Rendering , Yuki Yuna Is a Hero ), who composed the theme for Thor (Jane Foster). The game's staff also revealed the full Year 1 roster.

The Year 1 full roster includes Phoenix Cyclops, which will be added to the game on November 2; Thor (Jane Foster); Venom (spring 2027); and Jubilee (summer 2027).

The game launched for PlayStation 5 and PC via Steam and the Epic Games Store on August 6 (August 7 in Japan).

The game's Ultimate Edition includes pre-order bonuses, five character costumes, animated chromatic colors unlocked for all 20 launch characters, and the Year One pass that includes four characters and one stage.

Launch characters include: Ms. Marvel, Spider-Man, Peni Parker, Star-Lord, Storm, Wolverine, Magik, Danger, Doctor Doom, Captain America, Iron Man, Hulk, Black Panther, Magneto, Goblin, Carnage, Ghost Rider, Blade, Loki, and Deadpool.

The game has an Episode Mode single-player game mode, which presents a story in a motion comic format. The developers stated "a renowned writer from the original Marvel Comics " helped build the world and write the story of Episode Mode.

Daisuke Suzuki directed the opening movie at animation studio SANZIGEN . Keiko Terada ( SHOW-YA ) and mayu ( NEMOPHILA ) perform the original theme song "Stronger as One." Kanata Okajima wrote the lyrics. MEG (MEGMETAL) composed and arranged the song.
